## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Adapter protocol changes remain vendor-neutral and backward-compatible
- [ ] Documentation and examples match behavior
- [ ] No secrets or private content are included

## Security and permissions

List any changes to network access, adapter permissions, authentication, file handling, or model output validation. Write `None` when there are no changes.
